chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanty, who said: He narrated to me from Abdullah ibn Sin'an, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He said: Major ritual ablution (ghusl) is required in fourteen circumstances: the ghusl of the deceased, the ghusl of the one in a state of major impurity (janib), the ghusl of the one who washed the deceased, the ghusl of Friday, the two Eids, the day of Arafat, the ghusl of Ihram and entering the Ka'ba, entering the Ka'ba, entering the Sanctuary (Haram), the visitation (Ziyarah), the night of the nineteenth, the twenty-first, and the twenty-third of the month of Ramadan.

key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: One in a state of major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: What are the fourteen circumstances requiring ghusl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq enumerates fourteen distinct occasions requiring ghusl, highlighting the comprehensive nature of ritual purity in Shia jurisprudence. This list uniquely emphasizes the spiritual significance of specific nights in Ramadan (19th, 21st, and 23rd) and the transition into sacred states like Ihram and entering the Ka'ba, reflecting the integration of physical cleanliness with devotional readiness.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 14-5 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanty, on the authority of Abdullah ibn Sin’an, on the authority of Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), “

One should make major ritual ablutions (ghusl) in fourteen circumstances:1- For the deceased.2- After becoming impure due to sexual intercourse.3- Once you perform the major ritual ablutions (ghusl) for the deceased and shroud the corpse, or when you touch the corpse after if gets cold.4- On Fridays.5- On the day of Eid ul-Azha.6- On the day of Eid ul-Fitr.7- On the day of Arafat. 8- On the day of wearing the Ihram (Taharrum) and entering the House of God.9- Upon entering the Ka’ba. 10- Upon entering the Shrines in Mecca and Medina. 11- On the pilgrimage day. 12- On the night of the 19th of Ramazan (on which one’s destiny is recorded). 13- On the night of the 21st of Ramazan (on which the Trustees of the Prophets have died, Jesus - the son of Mary (MGB) was raised up to Heaven and Moses (MGB) died). 14- On the night of the 23rd of Ramazan (which is hoped to be the Night of Power). ”
